# Aravali Marbles

Aravali Marbles is a Purnea-based showroom and service provider for floor and wall tiles, pipes and fittings, sanitaryware and faucets, plywood, laminates, doors and frames, water tanks, tile adhesives, composite granite and interior designing.

Primary service areas:
- Purnea / Purnia
- Katihar
- Araria
- Kishanganj
- Madhepura
- Bhagalpur
- Nearby Bihar locations

- Projects: https://aravalimarbles.in/projects
- Contact: https://aravalimarbles.in/contact
- Blog: https://aravalimarbles.in/blog

Core topics:
- Best tiles in Purnia
- Best interior designer in Purnia

- Floor tiles, wall tiles, bathroom tiles and kitchen tiles
- Sanitaryware, faucets, wash basins and water closets
- CPVC pipes, SWR pipes, plumbing fittings and water tanks
- Tile adhesive, grout, composite granite and interior materials
